_comment: ENTRY-CORE calibration (the dual-oscillator buy signal). Two staged phases: tune RSI first, then the Stochastic over the RSI survivors. Everything else inherits PIKK DefaultParams. This is the heart of the strategy — run it even if the screen says all filters are dead. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_cal_entry.json -out ./reports/PIKK_entry -months 12 -train-months 6 -test-months 3 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
